tweets.text:
Today, @Sec_Noem announced partial termination of the Offshore Patrol Cutter (OPC) contract with Eastern Shipbuilding Group, cancelling production of OPCs 3 and 4. Continuing the @USCG modernization through Force Design 2028, this action will help maximize America’s investment in the Coast Guard while ensuring on-time, on-budget acquisitions.

The Coast Guard remains intent on acquiring and delivering the full OPC class as fast as possible. As an essential element of the Nation’s layered maritime security strategy, OPCs will complement the capabilities of the Service’s National Security Cutters, Fast Response Cutters and Polar Security Cutters.

Press release: https://t.co/gR1sRJ5g9B
#ForceDesign2028
@DHSgov

tweets.text:
As America’s maritime first responder, the U.S. Coast Guard is always ready to respond to crises or contingencies that may come with little or no warning.

Last weekend, Coast Guard members continued that legacy, responding to the tragic floods in central Texas and assisting more than 200 people on the ground. Today, a Coast Guard aircrew was recognized by @POTUS  and @Sec_Noem .

We extend our sympathies to the victims and families impacted by last week’s catastrophic flooding, and continue to stand with the people of Texas.

#USCG #AmericasFirstResponder #ValuetoNation

tweets.text:
Being always ready means preparing for the unexpected. Through recent tactical exercises, Maritime Safety and Security Team (MSST) New York strengthened their readiness to control, secure, and defend our ports and waterways. @USCG leadership, presence, and vigilance in America’s vital ports and waterways are instrumental to safeguarding the homeland and restoring U.S. maritime dominance.

As the Nation’s finest maritime fighting force, the Coast Guard is modernizing its capabilities and prioritizing agility, resilience, and mission readiness across our workforce. MSST New York’s exhaustive training embodies our efforts to forge the most agile, capable, and responsive force.

tweets.text:
Value to Nation: Across the Coast Guard’s range of missions, our men and women are dedicated to keeping Americans safe and delivering on the Nation’s historic investment in the Service. We continue to surge resources to control, secure, and defend 31,000 miles of U.S. maritime borders — where defense of America begins.

We are combating foreign terrorist organizations, cartels, and transnational organized crime.

We facilitate commerce vital to economic security and strategic mobility.

We are always ready to respond to a crisis or contingency that may come with little or no warning.

Continuing our transformation through Force Design 2028, the Coast Guard remains focused on maximizing value to the Nation through the most agile, capable, and responsive maritime fighting force.

#USCG #CoastGuard #ValueToNation #SemperParatus #ForceDesign2028 @DHSgov
